question: Related Questions Q. Inheritance of Property - when the intention of the son who financed the property was not clear 1518 views Q. Wealth distribution 1627 views Q. Inheritance 1862 views Q. We have a house of our great grandmother who had 2 sons and 2 daughters 1414 views Q. As Salaamualaikum dear Mufti sahib. My father has two sisters. Now my father also passed away and the two of my Aunties ( My fathers Sisters ) are claiming the entire property and are refusing to give any thing to me as my father also didnot recieve any share in that period when all were alive. Kindly mention how much share is mine according to shariah and also tell how to claim it. 1584 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 28255 Country: India Title: My Ques 1. Relatives share in property relatives which are eliglible 2. Things which are distributed ie Agriculture land, Home, gold, cash,etc. Question: Assalamu Alaikum My Ques 1. Relatives share in property relatives which are eliglible 2. Things which are distributed ie Agriculture land, Home, gold, cash,etc. Answer ID: 28255 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 54/44/H=1432) If you want to know the ruling of inheritance, you should send the name of the deceased person and the detail of his legal heirs and get it written by some Alim, then you shall be answered in-sha-Allah. And if you want to know something else, explain the question a bit more or get it written by some Alim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
